gaps.reason: This First Draft release cannot yet import this Foundation Plan capability.
gaps.consequence: This Plan path is omitted from the admitted Project graph and generated application.

gaps.reason: The Plan sets no application.domain, so the iOS Release build uses the placeholder origin https://trail-log.invalid and the placeholder bundle ID invalid.firstdraft.trail-log.
gaps.consequence: The Release build points at these placeholders, so it cannot reach a server or be submitted to the App Store. Set application.domain, or replace both values, before a Release build; the bundle ID cannot change after the app is published.
